summary: Package fetches and eval()s remote JavaScript from an anonymous blob host on import
details: The package's main module unconditionally fetches JavaScript from https://bdmkaoyijqmqa6bg.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/script.js and passes the response body to eval() at import time. The destination is a mutable, anonymous Vercel Blob URL unrelated to any documented sqlite functionality, so whatever bytes the URL currently serves execute in the Node.js process of any consumer that requires or imports the package. The package name (@sqlite-labs/createsql) suggests SQL tooling but the shipped code performs no SQL work — its only effect on load is the remote fetch-and-eval.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
